verdict.rationale: Founder Law is a founder-focused immigration firm. It references founder work visas, founders executing O-1 and H-1B petitions, leaving employer sponsorship to start a company, and Delaware C-Corp formation, which implies it handles a founder's own startup acting as petitioner. However, none of the cited pages actually documents how a self-owned startup can petition. Missing for 10: documentation of beneficial-ownership rules, board or employer-control arrangements (the employer-employee relationship), and any reference to the 2023+ USCIS founder/entrepreneur guidance, plus independent corroboration.
